marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF510B ratchet is a 20‑V, 3/8‑in square drive tool that delivers up to 75 ft‑lb of torque and operates at 0 to 300 RPM. It features a brushless motor, a variable‑speed trigger, an LED work light, and an interchangeable anvil that supports 3/8‑in and 1/4‑in square drives as well as a 1/4‑in hex quick‑release. The Li‑Ion battery and trigger switch provide power and control for trade applications.
